ideas.title: Following the Money: A Deep Dive into the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme and track the flow of money from government funding to the individuals and organizations involved.
questions: How did the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme work?
Who was involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. I will use data analysis and public records to track the flow of money and identify key players.
